study_identification_part.si_4_title: Probing individual-level structural atrophy in frontal glioma patients

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: All subjects (45 glioma patients and 51 healthy controls) were prospectively recruited and scanned at Beijing Tiantan Hospital, Capital Medical University, Beijing, China, using a single Philips Ingenia 3.0T MRI scanner. Patients were enrolled between May 2019 and July 2020; healthy controls were recruited from the local community and universities. No named public dataset was used.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "All subjects were scanned with a Philips Ingenia 3.0 T MRI scanner at Beijing Tiantan Hospital." "All patients were prospectively enrolled between May 2019 and July 2020, and all healthy controls were recruited from the local community and universities."
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.location: Zhang2022.pdf.md: Structural MRI acquisition, L54; Subjects, L48

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: The 51 healthy controls were used to build normative GM and WM volume models via GLM. Individual glioma patients' brain volumes were then compared against this normative model to generate structural abnormality maps (SAM) and compute abnormality indexes. No separate train/validation/test split is described for the normative model.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "a normative brain volume model was constructed using the healthy controls' data. General linear model (GLM) was adopted to discover the relationship between brain volume and variables including age, sex and total intracranial volume (TIV)" "for each glioma patient, an individual SAM was generated by calculating a W score for each voxel"
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Zhang2022.pdf.md: Generation of individual structural abnormality map, L87-L96

model-1.model-name: normative brain volume model (GM and WM)

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: A single normative model was built from all 51 healthy controls using GLM with age, sex, and TIV as covariates. Separate GM and WM normative volume models were constructed, but both used the same 51 HC. No train/test split of the HC data is described; all 51 HC appear to have been used to build the model. An initial cohort of 117 HC was recruited, but after exclusion criteria, 51 were included.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: "A final cohort of 45 patients...and 51 age-matched healthy controls...were included in the study." "a normative brain volume model was constructed using the healthy controls' data."
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.location: Zhang2022.pdf.md: Subjects, L48; Generation of individual structural abnormality map, L87

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: The 51 healthy controls had a mean age of 42.6 years (SD = 9.7). Since all 51 HC were used to build the normative model without a train/test split, overall-phase and train-phase values are identical. Inclusion criteria for patients stated '>18 years old', and HC were 'age-matched', but explicit min/max ages for HC are not reported. Median and IQR are not reported.
dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.supporting_text: "51 age-matched healthy controls (24 men, 27 women, age = 42.6 ± 9.7 years, all right-handed)"

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Of 51 healthy controls, 24 were men and 27 were women. Female percentage: 27/51 = 52.9%; Male percentage: 24/51 = 47.1%. Since no train/test split was used, overall and train phase are identical.
dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.supporting_text: "51 age-matched healthy controls (24 men, 27 women, age = 42.6 ± 9.7 years, all right-handed)"
